subject: Pilot support request: Skyloom accelerator demo runway
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@skyloom.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit ask to cover accelerator demo week

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the Redwood runtime looked really promising for the live demo we have in two weeks. We’re in the middle of an accelerator cohort and the demo runway has shifted: our expected token consumption for the next 6 weeks is ~3.2M tokens (higher than the original pilot plan).

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a short-term uplift to our pilot credits to cover the increased usage through the demo period? Specifically we’re asking for a one-time top-up equivalent to $5,000 in hosted credits and permission to extend the trial window by 30 days to finish the cohort deliverables and record the demo.

Attached is a one-pager with last month’s usage and an outline of the demo milestones (Skyloom_MVP_metrics.pdf). Happy to share a short case study & co-marketing note after the demo.

High level timeline:
- Week 0: finalize integration + smoke tests
- Week 1-2: internal cohort demos + external stakeholder rehearsal
- Week 3: public demo (recorded)

If helpful I can send a quick mutual action plan and provide billing contacts for procurement. Appreciate any flexibility here — this demo could be a strong reference for both teams.

Best,
Elena
Founder & CEO, Skyloom Labs

Attachment: Skyloom_MVP_metrics.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skyloom.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 13:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit ask to cover accelerator demo week

Thanks Elena — appreciate the context and the one-pager.

Ben, looping you and Laura in to see what we can do here. A couple quick clarifying questions for the request so we can scope the uplift and approvals:
- Can you share expected peak TPS / concurrency during the demo rehearsals?
- Is the $5k uplift strictly hosted credits or do you need dedicated burst capacity?
- Do you have procurement or contract constraints that would prevent a 30-day trial extension?

From a program perspective, we often approve conditional uplifts for accelerator cohorts in exchange for a short post-demo case study + a short product feedback session. If procurement is required, Laura will advise on contract amendment language.

Elena — if you can reply with the TPS numbers and confirm the billing contact, I’ll put together a recommendation for the approvals chain today.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Startup Programs Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@skyloom.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 09:30:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit ask to cover accelerator demo week

Elena — great to meet you earlier. I ran a quick usage projection based on the PDF you shared and the cohort cadence you described. Two proposals to expedite approvals:

Option A (fast): one-time hosted credit top-up equivalent to $4,000 + 30 day trial extension. Condition: Skyloom records the demo, allows a short customer quote, and completes a 30-minute product feedback interview within 10 business days after the demo.

Option B (preferred): $6,000 credit uplift stretched over 90 days, with reserved burst slots for two demo days (we can guarantee concurrency up to 64 tokens/ms; procurement preference permitting). Condition: we co-publish a short case study and join Redwood Accelerators webinar.

I attached a mutual action plan to this message to make the milestone conditions explicit (Skyloom_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx). If procurement wants an amendment we can route a short SOW; otherwise we can process hosted credits via the customer portal once the DocuSign is completed.

Deal info: DL-2028-1792. If Soojin gives the nod I’ll move this into HubSpot and generate the DocuSign envelope.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Growth Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Skyloom_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@skyloom.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2028 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit ask to cover accelerator demo week

Thanks team — quick governance note from Legal/Finance: we can approve a pilot credit exception but need two items before we finalize the uplift: a completed security questionnaire (to validate any data handling during the demo) and a one‑page amendment that limits the credit to hosted usage only (no dedicated capacity unless a purchase order is issued).

Operational constraints: credits must be applied to the HubSpot/Account ID and will be time‑bound (we can do 30 days or 90 days as proposed). For Option B, Finance requires a short PR approval if we co-publish a case study (brand use).

If Skyloom can provide the billing contact and confirm they agree to the case study conditions, I’m happy to green-light the $5k equivalent on a conditional basis. I’ll put language into a short approval note and circulate.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachment: support-approval-note.txt (text)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skyloom.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit ask to cover accelerator demo week

Elena — good news: we can approve a conditional $5,000 hosted credit uplift and a 30‑day trial extension to cover your demo runway. Conditions to close the loop:
1) Skyloom signs the short amendment via DocuSign (link below).
2) Complete the short security questionnaire attached to the DocuSign (this is a checklist only).
3) Record the demo and provide a 1 paragraph quote for a possible case study within 14 days of the demo.
4) Provide billing contact for credit application in HubSpot.

Next steps from our side: Ben will open the deal DL-2028-1792 in HubSpot and generate the DocuSign envelope. Once DocuSign is signed and the questionnaire is returned, Finance will apply the $5k hosted credits to your account and we’ll confirm the extended trial window.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-signature
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DL-2028-1792

Looking forward to the demo — let me know if you need a short technical check-in before rehearsals.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Startup Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
